name: Gravity Forms
summary: Self-hosted WordPress form builder with conditional logic, payments and deep integrations.
best_for: WordPress site owners and developers who want powerful, self-hosted forms with conditional logic, payments and deep integrations they fully control
skip_if: you're not on WordPress, or you want a hosted drag-and-drop builder with no plugin maintenance
honest_knock: Two honest notes. It's a WordPress-only plugin — no WordPress, no Gravity Forms — and its real power often lives in paid add-ons and third-party extensions, so a genuinely advanced setup can cost more than the base license suggests. It's developer-friendly rather than beginner-slick; non-technical users may find hosted builders more polished. For a WordPress site, though, it's the reliable gold standard.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-23 against the vendor's own pricing page) Annual WordPress licences, unchanged since 1 Sep 2026: Basic $59/yr (1 site, standard support), Pro $159/yr (3 sites, standard support), Elite $259/yr (unlimited sites, WordPress Multisite, priority support and every first-party add-on). Which add-on sits where decides the tier as often as the site count: Basic carries the email-marketing and anti-spam add-ons (HubSpot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Brevo, Kit, reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare Turnstile among them); Pro adds the payment and workflow ones (Stripe, PayPal Checkout, Square, Mollie, Zapier, Slack, Dropbox, Zoho CRM); Elite alone has Webhooks, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Coupons, Partial Entries, Signature, Survey, Quiz, Polls, User Registration, Conversational Forms, Advanced Post Creation and 2Checkout. No trial version, only an online demo. No renewal rate is published on the page. Refund policy: 30 days from each payment, covering original purchases, renewals and upgrades; a refund request deactivates the licence immediately and a deactivated licence cannot be renewed or reactivated; no partial refunds. On WordPress.com the plugin needs the Business plan with a custom domain. The third-party extensions most advanced builds lean on are separate purchases with their own ladders, all re-read 23 Sep 2026 and unchanged: Gravity Perks $59/$169/$299 a year, Gravity Flow $99/$299/$447, and GravityKit $119 for GravityView, $199 for GravityView Pro and $396 for the All Access Pass, the three GravityKit prices still shown with a first-year sale ($79.34, $132.67 and $264.01).
